run_dft_input_generation: run the CLI to generate VASP DFT input directories from a prerelaxed structures JSON dataframe
write_vasp_directory: create VASP input files for a crystal structure using MPRelaxSet and write them to a directory
subsample_by_nary: subsample a structures DataFrame by chemical n-arity with proportional weighting and return weight map
parse_vasp: parse a VASP vasprun.xml file to extract the final relaxed structure and energy
get_equal_weights: compute equal inverse weights for each n-arity category in a structures DataFrame
